home.title: Power infrastructure, presented with clarity.
home.intro: A multilingual digital platform for technical energy products—designed to make complex systems easier to understand, specify, and trust.
home.principlesTitle: A foundation built around real product decisions

principles.title: Technical clarity
principles.text: Structured specifications and disciplined product narratives keep engineering detail readable.

principles.title: Global by design
principles.text: Every enabled language shares one coherent information architecture from day one.

principles.title: Built to evolve
principles.text: A coded template system gives every product a strong visual identity without sacrificing governance.

home.closingTitle: A precise starting point for a serious catalog.
home.closingText: The public shell, locale system, API boundary, and quality gates are being established before product content enters the platform.

about.title: Engineering confidence into every energy decision.
about.intro: Maglive brings product detail, technical communication, and international presentation into one disciplined digital experience.
paragraphs: This first release establishes the permanent structure for a multilingual corporate catalog.
Company history, certifications, and operating details will be added only from verified source material.

products.title: A structured home for every product family.
products.intro: Products will be organized by a concise two-level taxonomy and rendered through professionally coded templates.
paragraphs: Catalog data is introduced in later phases after administration, media, and publication safeguards are complete.
products.note: No placeholder products or fabricated specifications are displayed.

projects.title: Project storytelling will follow verified delivery data.
projects.intro: This route is ready for future project content without pretending that a project CMS already exists.
paragraphs: A dedicated Project model, editorial workflow, and evidence requirements are intentionally outside version one.
projects.note: Project CMS is planned as a future module.

news.title: A clear channel for future company updates.
news.intro: The newsroom shell is code-owned today and will remain free of fabricated articles.
paragraphs: News publishing, authoring, and article metadata will be designed as a dedicated module when approved.
news.note: News CMS is planned as a future module.

downloads.title: Technical documents, organized around real products.
downloads.intro: Datasheets, certificates, and brochures will appear here when the secured media and product workflows are active.
paragraphs: Files will be reusable, reference-protected, localized where appropriate, and served from a replaceable storage provider.

contact.title: Start with the right technical conversation.
contact.intro: The version-one platform directs enquiries to approved contact channels without collecting submissions in an unapproved backend.
paragraphs: Verified regional contacts and privacy-reviewed enquiry handling will be configured before public launch.
contact.note: No contact form or personal data collection is active in this foundation phase.

footer.statement: Technical energy products, communicated with precision.
